effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have an [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When your [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon or Tamers are played, by suspending this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand.
[All Turns] All of your level 5 or higher [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it was played.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
